text:
Amira CSM: Heads-up — Skyward wants to onboard a tailored 7B for private (VPC) with HSM keywrap and strict PHI handling. Need to confirm safety eval scope and renewal risk.
Jorge SE: Got it. Do we know model format? HF repo, ggml, or a custom fp16 checkpoint?
Nikhil (Skyward): Hey team — it's a finetuned LLaMA-derivative, they gave us a tar with pytorch .pt files and a tokenizer.json. Target latency ~60ms token on dedicated A10x1.
Mira Sec: PHI note — what's the retention policy? Will they send live PHI in evaluation data or synthetic subsets? We need that for the compliance checklist.
Nikhil (Skyward): We'll share a redacted eval set first (synthetic + 10 redacted real examples). No permanent storage beyond short-term logs, but they need HSM for key custody.
Onboarding Bot: Checklist created: 1) Model binary format verified 2) Quantization plan 3) Evals + safety rubric 4) HSM/KMS integration 5) Network/VPC details. Link: https://redwood.app/onboard/6167001234 :clipboard: 
Jorge SE: For format: we can accept the PyTorch state dict. Recommend conversion to int8/4 quant for cost, but need a quality reg test. I'll post a minimal evaluation harness.
Jorge SE: Code snippet for quick smoke (run locally):
```bash
python eval_harness.py --model-path ./skyward/model.pt --input-file ./tests/sanity.json --batch-size 1
```
Amira CSM: Priya (PM) wants renewal risk flagged since this is an enterprise pilot. If latency/costs spike during peak, could affect renewal. Add a canary SLA and fallback policy.
Priya PM: Agree — propose a 2-week canary on Dedicated with throttled traffic + alerting on 3%+ token cost variance.
Mira Sec: Also require a signed DPA + SOC2 attestation from customer. I'll draft language — ping me their legal contact.
Nikhil (Skyward): Legal is @alex.singh@skyward.com — happy to loop them. Timeline: pilot starts in 3 weeks, need HSM test before then.
Jorge SE: I'll prep the conversion + a test quant profile. Can we get a sample input distribution? helps us pick sequence length for perf tuning.
Amira CSM: Nikhil — can you drop a 100-sample input distribution (anonymized) and confirm traffic pattern (QPS spikes)? I'll schedule a deep-dive next Tue 11am PT.
Nikhil (Skyward): Sending samples now to Amira. QPS avg 5, burst to 35 for short windows. Thanks — will be on the deep-dive.
Onboarding Bot: Task created: ENG-1248 (model format + quant) assigned to Jorge SE. ENG-1249 (HSM integration) assigned to Infra.
Jorge SE: One more — do we want on-the-fly KV caching for prefix reuse? If yes, need to instrument prompts for cacheability.
Amira CSM: Good call. Put that as an opt-in in the ops runbook. Also capture customer feedback after pilot week 1 and week 3 for renewal signals.
Mira Sec: Confirmed — I'll add data retention and HSM checklist items to the roster.
Amira CSM: Thanks team, I'll send calendar invite and update the playbook doc with links to the harness and checklist. :sparkles:
